summary: Divorce upheld on cruelty (false dowry complaint), desertion, irretrievable breakdown under Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 s.13(1)(ia)/s.13(1)(ib); mental cruelty inferred from unsubstantiated criminal complaint; prolonged 15-year separation; HC reappreciation of evidence sustained; Naveen Kohli/Samar Ghosh principles affirmed; marital bond dissolved.
legal_provisions_cited: Samar Ghosh v Jaya Ghosh (2006)4 SCC 558, (2007)4 SCC 511
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court decree of divorce sustained; marriage dissolved.
